consumer: The dialogue/condition u_has_item check (condition.cpp set_has_item) asking the yes/no 'does the avatar carry knife_combat?'
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory including nested non-gun/non-magazine container contents), not items reachable nearby
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t::set_has_item builds a lambda returning actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), an engine-computed possession predicate over the actor's own inventory
divergence: A knife_combat sealed inside a backpack/sheath (a non-gun, non-magazine container): has_amount recurses into contents and returns TRUE, but a re-derivation from the flat write_carried_items array (which lists only the top-level container, never the nested knife) answers FALSE
